fixes.what: Changed the SCRIPT path from tcb/scripts/snap.mjs to tcb/snap.mjs (flat build layout).
Changed the SCRIPT path from tcb/scripts/witness.mjs to tcb/witness.mjs (flat build layout). Before this, every witness test failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

T8b: the 'text file missing' card used GOOD_TEXT, which has the same text sha as the 'later failed retrieval' card. The later card's addTextSnapshot wrote the removed text file back, so the card was witnessed. The no-text card now gets a text of its own. The assertion is unchanged; the script was right.

T14's allowed half was skipped on the claim that the spec exports no filter function. But the spec asks for this table with no network, and snap.mjs exports addressAllowed. The skip is now a real test that calls the filter directly. It checks that the allowed addresses pass, that the spec's refused addresses fail (plus loopback and mapped loopback when allow_loopback is false), and that allow_loopback opens loopback only. This makes the test stronger.

Changed describe { concurrency: 3 } to { concurrency: 1 }. With three tests at once, up to 6 processes were alive together: each script run plus the PowerShell call for its lock identity. The brief forbids that kind of burst. No assertion changed, and the run still takes about 23 s.
